secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key (JWT). A local-dev value is in .env.base44-defaults; replace with your own Supabase project's anon key to use a remote project.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key (JWT). A local-dev value is in .env.base44-defaults; replace with your own Supabase project's service-role key for production.

secrets.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: 64-char hex key (32 bytes) for AES-256-GCM token encryption. A development placeholder is in .env.base44-defaults; replace with a real key for production (node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))").

secrets.name: META_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Meta App Secret for HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification. A development placeholder is in .env.base44-defaults; replace with your Meta for Developers App Secret for WhatsApp integration.
